advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Sefa matšatšikgwedi a dikarata ka @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt goba @listEnteredAt. Mohlala: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' goba @endAt = none. Bea leina la lefelo leo le itiretšwego leo le thomago ka @ magareng ga maswao a tsopolo.
advanced-filter-description: Sefe se se tšwetšego pele se go dumelela go ngwala mothaladi wo o nago le ditirišo tše: == != <= >= && || ( ) Sekgoba se dirišwa go aroganya ditirišo. O ka sefa mafelo ka moka a tlwaelo ka go ngwala maina le ditekanyetšo tša ona. Mohlala: Field1 == Value1. Ela hloko: Ge mafelo goba ditekanyetšo di na le dikgoba, o swanetše go di tsenya ka gare ga maswao a tee a go tsopola. Mohlala: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Go tshela ditlhaka tša taolo tše tee (' \/), o ka diriša \. Mohlala: Field1 == I\'m. O ka kopanya le maemo a mantši. Mohlala: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ka tlwaelo ditirišo ka moka di hlathollwa go tloga go la nngele go ya go la go ja. O ka fetoša tatelano ka go tsenya masakana. Mohlala: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). O ka nyaka gape mafelong a sengwalwa ka regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

email-emergency-access-subject: Phihlelelo ya tšhoganetšo: __admin__ o tsene bjalo ka __user__
email-emergency-access-text:
__admin__ o šomišitše phihlelelo ya tšhoganetšo go tsena bjalo ka __user__ go __url__ ka __time__.

Lebaka: __note__

Tšohle tšeo di dirilwego ka nako yeo di ka go Phanele ya molaodi / Batho / Pukwana ya tlhahlobo le Mathata / Pego ya go Itira Motho yo Mongwe.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Kgomaretša JSON ya ntšho ya Kanboard: sedirišwa se se nago le "columns" (goba mešomo ye e rwelego column_name) le lenaneo la "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Dikholomo di ba mananeo gomme mešomo ya ba dikarata.
import-board-instruction-deck: Kgomaretša JSON ya boto ya NextCloud Deck (boto ye e nago le "stacks", mokgobo o mongwe le o mongwe o rwala "cards" tša wona). Mekgobo e ba mananeo gomme dikarata tša ba dikarata.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Kgomaretša JSON ya kgoboketšo ya diphuthelwana tša mošomo tša OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Maemo a ba mananeo gomme diphuthelwana tša mošomo tša ba dikarata.
import-board-instruction-issues: Kgomaretša lenaneo la JSON la ditaba tša __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Ditaba di ba dikarata tše di hlophilwego ka mananeo a Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Kgomaretša JSON ya ntšho ya mešomo ya Asana ({ "data": [...] } go tšwa ntšhong ya Asana goba GET /tasks). Mešomo e hlophwa ka dikarolo (memberships); mešomo ye e phethilwego e ya go Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Kgomaretša JSON ya ntšho ya lenaneo la ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Magato a ba mananeo gomme dilo tša ba dikarata.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Kgomaretša lelokelelo la mešomo ya markdown (mokgwa woo dithulusi tša markdown-kanban tša go swana le Obsidian Kanban di o šomišago): dihlogo tša "## Leina la lelokelelo", le dilo tša "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ka tlase. Dihlogo di fetoga malokelelo gomme dilo di fetoga dikarata.
import-board-instruction-leo: Kgomaretša sebopego sa Leo (faele ya .leo). Dikarolo tša maemo a godimo di fetoga malokelelo, dikarolo tše di lego ka fase ga tšona thwii di fetoga dikarata, gomme sengwalwa sa karolo se ba tlhalošo ya karata. Dikarolo tša maemo a go tsenelela di fetoga malokelelo a tlhahlobo. Dikarolo tše di swailwego di tsenywa bjalo ka tše di phethilwego.
import-board-instruction-opml: Kgomaretša kakaretšo ya OPML, bjalo ka ge Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq le tše dingwe di e romela. Dilo tša godimo di fetoga malokelelo, bana ba tšona ba fetoga dikarata gomme ngwalwana e ba tlhalošo, gomme dilo tše di tseneletšego kudu di fetoga malokelelo a tlhahlobo. Dilo tše di feditšwego di tsenywa bjalo ka tše di feditšwego.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Kgomaretša faele ya Org mode, bjalo ka ge Emacs, Orgzly goba Beorg di e ngwala. Dihlogo tša godimo di fetoga malokelelo gomme dihlogo tša legato la bobedi di fetoga dikarata. TODO le DONE, dintlha tša pele, ditaki, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE le CLOSED di a bolokwa, gomme mapokisi a go kgetha le dihlogo tše di tseneletšego di fetoga malokelelo a tlhahlobo.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Kgomaretša faele ya todo.txt: mošomo o tee mothalading o mongwe le o mongwe, bjalo ka ge tirišo ya todo.txt le ditirišo tše di sepelelanago le yona di ngwala. Mešomo ye e phethilwego ("x") e ya karolong ye e phethilwego, +project le @context di fetoga dileibole, (A) e fetoga leibole ya bohlokwa, gomme due: le t: di fetoga matšatši a mafelelo le a go thoma.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Kgomaretša sephetho sa task export: lenaneo la JSON goba mošomo o tee mothalading o mongwe le o mongwe. Mešomo ye e phethilwego e ya go Done, project le priority di fetoga diswayo, annotations e fetoga ditshwayotshwayo, gomme depends e fetoga go ithekga ka mešomo ye e thibelago.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Ntšha faele ya .boardarchive polokelong ye e gateletšwego gomme o kgomaretše diteng tša board.jsonl ya boto, le mothaladi wa phetolelo goba ntle le wona. Sebopego sa go hlopha ponong ya boto se fetoga mananeo, dibopego tše dingwe tša kgetho di fetoga diswayo, dikarolo tša sengwalwa le mapokisi a go swaya di fetoga tlhalošo le lelokelelo la tlhahlobo, gomme ditshwayotshwayo di a bolokwa. Diswantšho le difaele tše di kgomareditšwego ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-azuredevops: Ka go Azure DevOps, bula Boards, ke moka Queries, šomiša potšišo yeo e bontšhago dikholomo tšeo o di nyakago, gomme o kgethe Export to CSV; ke moka kgetha faele yeo ya .csv. Board Column (goba State) e fetoga malokelelo gomme Board Lane ditsela; dilo tša mošomo di fetoga dikarata le mohuta wa tšona le di-tags bjalo ka diswayo, Assigned To, matšatši, tlhaloso le motswadi, gomme dikholomo tše dingwe di fetoga mašemo a gago.
import-board-instruction-mslists: Ka go Microsoft Lists, bula lelokelelo, kgetha Export, ke moka Export to CSV, gomme o kgethe faele yeo ya .csv. Kholomo ya Status (goba Progress) e fetoga malokelelo gomme selo se sengwe le se sengwe karata, le hlogo ya sona, tlhaloso, batho, matšatši le di-tags; dikholomo tše dingwe di fetoga mašemo a gago.
import-board-instruction-msproject: Ka go Microsoft Project, kgetha File, ke moka Save As, ka mohuta wa XML Format (*.xml), gomme o kgethe faele yeo. Mešomo ya kakaretšo e fetoga ditsela gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata go Not started, In progress goba Completed, le matšatši a yona, dintlha, methopo, mešomo-potlana le yeo e e etilego pele.
import-board-instruction-outlook: Ka go Outlook, goga melaetša o e iše foldareng khomphuthareng ya gago, goba o e boloke ka File, ke moka Save As, bjalo ka Outlook Message Format (*.msg). Kgetha faele e tee ya .msg, goba .zip ya difaele tša .msg le .eml. Poledišano ye nngwe le ye nngwe e fetoga karata go Board View / Email, le dikarabo tša yona bjalo ka ditshwaotshwao le dikgokaganyo bjalo ka difaele.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Go MeisterTask, kgotla leina la projeke, kgetha Export project gomme o romele CSV, ke moka o e kgomaretše. Dikarolo di fetoga malokelelo gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata, le dingwalwana, letšatši la mafelelo, yo a filwego mošomo le ditaki; mešomo ye e feditšwego e boloka letšatši la go fetša. CSV ye e ngwaletšwego go tsenya ga MeisterTask ka boyona le yona e a šoma.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Go Obsidian, bula faele ya poto ya Kanban bjalo ka Markdown (goba bula faele ya .md ka sehlophi sa sengwalwa), ke moka o kgomaretše ka moka ga yona. Ditsela di fetoga malokelelo le mellwane ya tšona ya dikarata, dikarata di boloka ditaki, matšatši, bohlokwa, mašemo le lelokelelo la tlhahlobo, gomme Archive e fetoga dikarata tše di bolokilwego polokelong.
import-board-instruction-linear: Go Linear, romela mathata bjalo ka CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, goba go romela ga pono), ke moka o kgomaretše CSV. Maemo a fetoga malokelelo, dihlopha di fetoga ditsela, gomme mathata a fetoga dikarata le yo a filwego mošomo, diswayo, matšatši, bothata bja motswadi, bohlokwa, kakanyo, projeke le modikologo.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Go TickTick, bula Settings, Account, Backup & Import gomme o dire kopi ya polokego, ke moka o kgomaretše faele ya CSV. Lelokelelo le lengwe le le lengwe la TickTick le fetoga tsela gomme dikholomo tša lona di fetoga malokelelo; mešomo e boloka ditaki, matšatši, lelokelelo la tlhahlobo, bohlokwa le mešomo-potlana.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Go ClickUp, romela mešomo bjalo ka CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, goba go romela ga pono ya List goba Table le dikholomo ka moka), ke moka o kgomaretše CSV. Maemo a fetoga malokelelo, malokelelo a ClickUp a fetoga ditsela, gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata le mešomo-potlana, bao ba filwego mošomo, ditaki, matšatši, bohlokwa le nako.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Go Nullboard, bula poto, kgetha Export this board... go menyu, bula faele ya .nbx ka sehlophi sa sengwalwa gomme o kgomaretše diteng tša yona. Malokelelo a fetoga malokelelo gomme dingwalwana di fetoga dikarata: mothaladi wa pele wa ngwalwana ke sehlogo sa karata gomme tše dingwe ke tlhalošo. Ngwalwana ye e sa šongwago e hwetša leswao raw. Faele ye e nago le dipoto tše mmalwa e tsenya poto ya yona ya pele.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Go Kanri, bula Import & Export gomme o kgethe Export individual board (goba Export all data), ke moka o kgomaretše faele ya .json. Dikholomo di fetoga malokelelo gomme dikarata di fetoga dikarata, le tlhalošo, letšatši la mafelelo, ditaki le mebala; mešomo ya karata e fetoga lelokelelo la tlhahlobo. Go romelweng ga data ka moka, poto ya pele e a tsenywa.
import-board-instruction-planka: Ngwala aterese ya Planka ya gago (mohlala https://planka.example.com), leina la mošomiši le lentšu la sephiri la Planka, ke moka o tobetše «Bontšha seo se ka tsenywago». Di šomišwa fela go tliša letlapa gomme ga di bolokwe. Kgetha letlapa o tobetše «Tliša»: WeKan e le bala go tšwa go API ya Planka gotee le malokelelo a lona, dikarata, ditlhaloso, matšatši a mafelelo, diswayo, maloko, malokelelo a mešomo le ditshwayo, ke moka o tšwele pele ka go tsenya bjalo ka mehleng. Dikarata tšeo di lego polokelong ya Planka di tsenywa di bolokilwe; ditlhomeletšo le dikarata tšeo di lego ka moleteng wa matlakala ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Go Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), tsena, dumelela tumelelo ya Tasks.Read gomme o kopiše token go tšwa go thepo ya Access token. E kgomaretše mo gomme o kgotle «Bontšha seo se ka tsenywago»; token e šomišwa fela go go tliša mo gomme ga e bolokwe. Kgetha malokelelo ka moka goba le tee gomme o kgotle «Tliša». Lelokelelo le lengwe le le lengwe la To Do le ba lelokelelo gomme modiro wo mongwe le wo mongwe o ba karata, gotee le dintlha, matšatši a mafelelo le a go thoma, dikgato bjalo ka lelokelelo la tlhahlobo, magoro bjalo ka diswayo, bohlokwa bjo bogolo le maemo bjalo ka diswayo; mediro ye e feditšwego e a bolokwa. Dikgopotšo le dipoeletšo ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-onenote: Ka go Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), tsena, dumelela tumelelo ya Notes.Read gomme o kopiše token go tswa go thebe ya Access token. E kgomaretše mo gomme o kgotle «Bontšha seo se ka tsenywago»; token e šomišwa fela go tliša mo gomme ga e bolokwe. Kgetha puku ya dintlha gomme o kgotle «Tliša». Dikarolo di fetoga malokelelo gomme matlakala a fetoga dikarata, le sengwalwa sa ona, mapokisi a dilo tše di swanetšego go dirwa bjalo ka lelokelelo la tlhahlobo le matlakala-potlana bjalo ka mešomo-potlana.
import-board-instruction-teams: Kgomaretša token ya go tsena ya Microsoft Graph ye e nago le Chat.Read (go tšwa go Graph Explorer, akhaonto ya mošomo goba ya sekolo) gomme o kgotle «Bontšha seo se ka tsenywago», ke moka kgetha poledišano goba kanale gomme o kgotle «Tliša»; token ga e bolokwe. Goba kgetha faele: .tar ya thomelo ya gago ya motho go tšwa go teams.live.com/dataexport, goba .json ya melaetša ya poledišano. Poledišano ye nngwe le ye nngwe e fetoga karata go Board View / Chat, gomme melaetša ya yona ditshwaotshwao.
import-board-instruction-sandstorm: Ka Sandstorm, bula grain ya __app__, kgetha "Download backup" go bara ya godimo ya grain, gomme o kgethe faele yeo ya .zip. Diteng tša grain di ba poto, dilo tša yona e ba dikarata le seo app e se bolokago ka tšona. Kgetha app yeo grain e lego ya yona: grain ya app ye nngwe e a ganwa, gomme e bolela gore ke app efe.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Go KanbanFlow, bula menyu ya letlapa, kgetha Settings → API & Webhooks gomme o kopiše token ya API ya letlapa. Kgomaretša token mo, kgotla «Bontšha seo se ka tsenywago», kgetha letlapa gomme o kgotle «Tliša»; token e šomišwa fela go go tliša moo gomme ga e bolokwe. Dikholomo di ba malokelelo gomme ditsela di dula e le ditsela; mediro e boloka tlhaloso, mmala, diswayo, letšatši la mafelelo, mediro ye menyenyane bjalo ka lelokelelo la tlhahlobo, nako ye e šomišitšwego, kakanyo, batho le ditshwayo.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Ngwala ID ya akhaonte ya gago ya Basecamp (nomoro ka morago ga basecamp.com/ atereseng) le token ya phihlelelo (go tšwa go app ya OAuth 2 ye e ngwadišitšwego go launchpad.37signals.com, goba yeo kopanyo ye e lego gona e šetšego e na le yona), kgotla «Bontšha seo se ka tsenywago», kgetha protšeke gomme o kgotle «Tliša». Token e šomišwa fela go go tliša moo gomme ga e bolokwe. Tafola ye nngwe le ye nngwe ya dikarata e ba tsela gotee le dikholomo tša yona bjalo ka malokelelo, gomme malokelelo a dilo tša go dirwa a ba tsela «To-dos»; dikarata le dilo tša go dirwa di boloka sengwalwa, matšatši, bao ba abetšwego le ditshwayo, dikgato tša karata di ba lelokelelo la tlhahlobo, gomme dilo tše di feditšwego di a bolokwa.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Hwetša token ya phihlelelo go OAuth 2.0 Playground: ka fase ga Tasks API v1 kgetha tasks.readonly, kgotla Authorize APIs, ke moka Exchange authorization code for tokens, gomme o kopiše token ya phihlelelo. E kgomaretše mo gomme o kgotle «Bontšha seo se ka tsenywago», kgetha malokelelo ka moka a mediro goba le tee, ke moka «Tliša». Token e šomišwa fela go go tliša mo gomme ga e bolokwe. Malokelelo a mediro a ba malokelelo gomme mediro e ba dikarata, gotee le dintlha, dikgokagano le letšatši la mafelelo; mediro ye menyenyane e ba lelokelelo la tlhahlobo gomme mediro ye e feditšwego e tsenywa e bolokilwe.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API ya Google Keep ke ya diakhaonte tša Google Workspace fela. Hwetša token ya phihlelelo ya OAuth 2.0 ka bophara bja https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (go OAuth 2.0 Playground ge molaodi wa Workspace ya gago a dumelela, goba go tšwa go akhaonte ya tirelo ye e nago le kabelo ya domeine ka moka), e kgomaretše, kgotla «Bontšha seo se ka tsenywago» ke moka «Tliša». Token e šomišwa fela go go tliša mo gomme ga e bolokwe. Dintlha tša sengwalwa di ba dikarata ka lelokelelong «Notes», gomme dintlha tša lelokelelo la tlhahlobo di ba dikarata ka lelokelelong «Lists» gotee le dilo tša tšona bjalo ka lelokelelo la tlhahlobo. Dintlha tše di lahlilwego, ditlhomeletšo le go abelana ga di tsenywe.
api-import-desc: E tliše go tšwa tirelong ka akhaonte ya gago. Seo o se ngwalago mo se šomišwa fela go go tliša mo gomme ga se bolokwe.
api-import-fetched: E tlišitšwe. Lekola maloko ka fase gomme o tsenye.
api-import-nothing: Ga go na seo se ka tsenywago ka akhaonte ye.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Go Pivotal Tracker, bula tab ya MORE ya projeke gomme o kgethe Export CSV (goba kgetha dikanegelo gomme o kgethe Bulk Actions, CSV), ke moka o kgomaretše CSV. Boemo bjo bongwe le bjo bongwe bja kanegelo bo fetoga lelokelelo gomme dikanegelo di fetoga dikarata, le mohuta le diswayo, beng, mokgopedi, matšatši, ditshwaotshwao, mešomo le dipharišo; Estimate e fetoga Story points gomme dipoeletšo di fetoga disprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Go Tasks.org, bula Settings, Backups gomme o kgethe Export tasks, ke moka o kgomaretše diteng tša faele yeo ya .json. Malokelelo a fetoga malokelelo gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata, le dingwalwana, ditaki, matšatši, ditshwaotshwao le mešomo-potlana; mešomo ye e feditšwego e boloka letšatši la go fetša, gomme bohlokwa bo fetoga lešemo la gago.
import-board-instruction-monday: Go monday.com, bula menyu ya poto, kgetha More actions le Export board to Excel (le dimpshafatšo le dilo-potlana ge o rata), ke moka o kgethe faele yeo ya .xlsx. Kholomo ya Status e fetoga malokelelo gomme dihlopha di fetoga ditsela; batho, matšatši, mothaladi wa nako le ditaki di boloka mafelo a tšona, dikholomo tše dingwe di fetoga mašemo a gago gomme dimpshafatšo di fetoga ditshwaotshwao.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Go Super Productivity, bula Settings, ke moka Sync & Backup, kgetha Export Data gomme o kgomaretše diteng tša faele ya sp-backup .json. Projeke ye nngwe le ye nngwe e fetoga tsela gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata go To Do, In Progress, Backlog goba Done, le dingwalwana, ditaki, letšatši la mafelelo, nako ye e šomišitšwego le mešomo-potlana; mešomo ye e bolokilwego polokelong e fetoga dikarata tše di bolokilwego polokelong.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Go Taiga, bula Admin > Project > Export gomme o theolle kopi ya projeke (pele o bule faele ya .json.gz), ke moka o kgomaretše JSON ya yona. Maemo a dikanegelo tša mošomiši a fetoga malokelelo, dikanegelo tša mošomiši di fetoga dikarata le mešomo ya tšona bjalo ka mešomo-potlana, di-epic le mathata di hwetša ditsela tša tšona, gomme disprint, ditaki, ditshwaotshwao le dika tša gago di tla le tšona. Ditlaleletšo ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Go Vikunja, bula Settings, kgetha Data Export gomme o theolle faele ya .zip ye e go romelago yona, ke moka o kgethe faele yeo, goba o kgomaretše data.json ye e lego ka gare ga yona. Dipakete tša Kanban di fetoga malokelelo gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata, le diswayo, bao ba filwego mošomo, matšatši, tlhalošo, malokelelo a mešomo bjalo ka malokelelo a tlhahlobo le ditshwaotshwao; bohlokwa, phesente ye e feditšwego le e feditšwe di fetoga mašemo a gago. Ditlaleletšo ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-quire: Go Quire, bula menyu ya projeke gomme o kgethe Export CSV, ke moka o kgomaretše CSV. Maemo a fetoga malokelelo gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata, le mešomo-potlana bjalo ka dikarata tša bana, bao ba filwego mošomo, ditaki bjalo ka diswayo, matšatši a go thoma, a mafelelo le a go fetša, tlhalošo le bohlokwa bjalo ka lešemo la gago. Ditshwaotshwao le ditlaleletšo ga di gona go CSV ya Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Go Wrike, romela projeke goba foltara go Excel, goba o tlatše thempoleiti ya go tsenya ya Excel ya Wrike, ke moka o kgethe faele yeo ya .xlsx. Methaladi ya foltara le ya projeke e fetoga ditsela, Status e fetoga malokelelo gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata, le Key, mošomo wa motswadi, bao ba filwego mošomo, matšatši a go thoma le a mafelelo, go ithekga le tlhalošo; Priority, Duration le dikholomo tše dingwe di fetoga mašemo a gago.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Go Teamwork.com, tlatša thempoleiti ya go tsenya mešomo ya Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) gomme o e boloke bjalo ka .xlsx, ke moka o kgethe faele yeo. Malokelelo a mešomo a fetoga malokelelo gomme mešomo e fetoga dikarata; mošomo wo o thomago ka -, # goba > o fetoga mošomo-potlana wa mošomo wo o lego ka godimo ga wona (--, ## goba >> legato le tee ka tlase). Bao ba filwego mošomo, matšatši le ditaki di boloka mafelo a tšona; Priority, Estimated time le Complete di fetoga mašemo a gago.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Go Businessmap (pele e be e le Kanbanize), bula Advanced Search, kgetha Configure results go kgetha dikholomo, theolla faele ya Excel, ke moka o kgethe faele yeo ya .xlsx. Dikholomo di balwa ka maina a tšona a Seisemane (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): ge akhaonto ya gago e šomiša polelo ye nngwe, pele o fetoše mothaladi wa dihlogo go Seisemane. Column e fetoga malokelelo gomme Lane ditsela; beng, ditaki, mmala, matšatši, ditshwaotshwao le dikgokagano tša motswadi di boloka mafelo a tšona, gomme Priority, Size, Type le dikholomo tše dingwe di fetoga mašemo a gago.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Go Redmine, bula Issues ya projeke, kgetha Also available in: CSV ka tlase ga lelokelelo, kgetha dikholomo (All columns, le Description) gomme o romele, ke moka o kgomaretše CSV. Redmine e reela dikholomo ka polelo ya gago, ka gona beakanya polelo ya gago go Seisemane go My account pele o romela. Boemo bjo bongwe le bjo bongwe bo fetoga lelokelelo gomme mathata a fetoga dikarata, le tracker bjalo ka leswao, yo a filwego mošomo, mongwadi, matšatši, mošomo wa motswadi le mathata a amanago; bohlokwa, legoro, phetolelo ye e nepilwego, nako ye e akantšwego, % Done le mašemo a gago di fetoga mašemo a gago.
import-board-instruction-notion: Go Notion, bula database bjalo ka letlakala ka moka, kgetha ••• le Export, kgetha Markdown & CSV, gomme o kgethe faele ya .zip ye e theollago, goba CSV e tee ya database go yona, goba o kgomaretše CSV yeo. Kholomo ye e bitšwago Status e fetoga malokelelo (ge e se gona, kholomo ya pele ye e lebelelagago bjalo ka kgetho e a dira, gomme pego ya go tsenya e bolela gore ke efe); methaladi e fetoga dikarata le sehlogo, ditaki bjalo ka diswayo, batho bjalo ka maloko, matšatši, le sengwalwa sa letlakala bjalo ka tlhalošo; dikholomo tše dingwe di fetoga mašemo a gago. Dikamano, diswantšho le ditlaleletšo ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-plane: Go Plane, bula Workspace Settings, kgetha Exports, romela diprojeke bjalo ka JSON, CSV goba Excel gomme o theolle faele ya .zip, ke moka o kgethe faele yeo, goba faele e tee ka gare ga yona, goba o kgomaretše JSON goba CSV. Maemo a fetoga malokelelo, diprojeke di fetoga ditsela, gomme mathata a fetoga dikarata le sešupo, motswadi, bao ba filwego mošomo, diswayo, matšatši, dikgokagano le ditshwaotshwao; bohlokwa, kakanyo, modikologo le mojule di fetoga mašemo a gago. Go romela ga Plane ga go na ditlhalošo goba ditlaleletšo, ka gona ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-fizzy: Ka Fizzy, romela ntle akhaonte go "Account settings", goba dikarata tša gago ka "Download my data", gomme o kgethe faele ya .zip yeo Fizzy e go romelago yona, goba faele ya .json ya karata e tee. Dipoto di fetoga ditsela gomme dikholomo di fetoga malokelelo, le "Maybe?", "Not now" le "Done" bjalo ka go Fizzy; dikarata di boloka tlhalošo ya tšona, diswayo, bao ba filwego mošomo, megato bjalo ka lelokelelo la tlhahlobo, ditshwaotshwao le difaele.
import-board-instruction-mail: Kgetha faele ya .mbox, bjalo ka ge Thunderbird, Apple Mail, mutt goba Gmail ka Google Takeout e e boloka, goba molaetša o tee wa .eml, goba o kgomaretše sengwalwa sa yona. Poledišano ye nngwe le ye nngwe e fetoga karata e tee lelokelelong la Inbox, le moromelwa, baamogedi le hlogo ya yona, gore e bonagale ponong ya Email; diphetolo di fetoga ditshwaotshwao tša yona. Diswayo tša Gmail di fetoga diswayo. Ditlaleletšo ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-ical: Kgetha faele ya khalentara ya .ics, bjalo ka ge Google Calendar, Apple Calendar goba Reminders, Thunderbird, Nextcloud goba Outlook di e romela ntle, goba o kgomaretše sengwalwa sa yona. Mešomo e ya go To Do, In Progress, Done goba Cancelled go ya ka maemo a yona, gomme ditiragalo di ya go Events, le matšatši a tšona a go thoma le a mafelelo, gore di bonagale ponong tša Calendar le Gantt. Magoro le bohlokwa di fetoga diswayo. Dilo tšeo di ipoeletšago di tsenywa gatee.
import-board-instruction-googletakeout: Go takeout.google.com, kgetha Tasks, Keep, Mail, Calendar le Google Chat, hlama thomelontle gomme o laolle faele ya .zip, ke moka o e kgethe mo. Setšweletšwa se sengwe le se sengwe se fetoga tsela: poso ya pono ya Email, malokelelo a mešomo le dintlha le malokelelo a tšona a tlhahlobo, ditiragalo tša khalentara le mešomo le matšatši, le mafelo a poledišano ao melaetša ya ona e lego ditshwaotshwao tša pono ya Chat. Ditšweletšwa tše dingwe le ditlaleletšo ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-slack: Ka go Slack, bula dipeakanyo tša workspace, kgetha Import/Export Data, romela ntle workspace gomme o laolle faele ya .zip, ke moka o e kgethe mo. Kanale ye nngwe le ye nngwe e fetoga karata ka go Channels, Groups goba Direct messages, gomme melaetša ya yona le diphetolo tša thread di fetoga ditshwaotshwao tša karata, go ya ka mongwadi, gore pono ya Chat e bontšhe kanale. Difaele ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-mattermost: Romela ntle ka mmctl export create, laolla thomelontle gomme o kgethe faele ya yona ya .jsonl, goba o kgomaretše sengwalwa sa yona. Kanale ye nngwe le ye nngwe le molaetša o lebanyago di fetoga karata, gomme diposo le diphetolo tša yona di fetoga ditshwaotshwao tša karata, gore pono ya Chat e bontšhe kanale. Dihlopha di fetoga ditsela. Difaele ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-telegram: Ka go Telegram Desktop, bula Settings, Advanced, Export Telegram data, kgetha sebopego sa JSON gomme o romele ntle, ke moka o kgethe faele ya result.json, goba o kgomaretše sengwalwa sa yona. Poledišano ye nngwe le ye nngwe e fetoga karata ka go Direct messages, Groups goba Channels, gomme melaetša ya yona e fetoga ditshwaotshwao tša karata, gore pono ya Chat e bontšhe poledišano. Diswantšho le difaele ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-whatsapp: Ka go WhatsApp, bula poledišano, kgetha Export chat ntle le media, gomme o kgethe faele ya .txt mo, goba o kgomaretše sengwalwa sa yona. Poledišano e fetoga karata yeo melaetša ya yona e lego ditshwaotshwao tša yona, go ya ka moromelwa le nako, gore pono ya Chat e e bontšhe. Media le melaetša ya tshepedišo ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-discord: Romela ntle kanale ya Discord ka DiscordChatExporter ka sebopego sa JSON gomme o kgethe faele ya .json, goba o kgomaretše sengwalwa sa yona. Kanale e fetoga karata ka legorong la yona, gomme melaetša ya yona e fetoga ditshwaotshwao tša karata, gore pono ya Chat e bontšhe kanale. Seva e fetoga tsela. Ditlaleletšo ga di tsenywe.
import-board-instruction-rocketchat: Ka Rocket.Chat, romela ntle data ya gago bjalo ka JSON go "My Data" gomme o kgethe faele ya .zip yeo e go romelago yona, goba faele ya .json ye e rometšwego ntle ya phapoši e tee. Phapoši ye nngwe le ye nngwe e fetoga karata gomme melaetša ya yona e fetoga ditshwaotshwao tša karata, gore pono ya Chat e bontšhe phapoši. Le .zip yeo WeKan e e romelago ntle bakeng sa setsenyi sa CSV sa Rocket.Chat e a balwa.
import-board-instruction-evernote: Ka go Evernote, romela ntle dintlha goba puku ya dintlha bjalo ka faele ya .enex gomme o e kgethe mo, goba o kgomaretše sengwalwa sa yona. Ntlha ye nngwe le ye nngwe e fetoga karata le sengwalwa sa yona, mabokose a yona a tša go dirwa bjalo ka lelokelelo la tlhahlobo, ditaga tša yona bjalo ka diswayo le kgopotšo ya yona bjalo ka letšatši la mafelelo; dintlha tšeo kgopotšo ya tšona e phethilwego di ya go Done. Diswantšho le difaele tše di kgomareditšwego ga di tsenywe.
tool-group-issues: Balatedi ba mathata le taolo ya diphetolelo
tool-group-tasks: Ditirišo tša mešomo le tše di swanetšego go dirwa
report-no-due-date: Ga go na letšatši la mafelelo
report-average-days-late: Matšatši a go diega a magareng
import-board-instruction-trello: Botong ya gago ya Trello, eya go 'Menu', ke moka 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', gomme o kopolle sengwalwa seo se tšweletšego.
import-board-instruction-csv: Kgomaretša Ditekanyetšo tše di Arogantšwego ka Diphefšana (CSV)/Ditekanyetšo tše di Arogantšwego ka Dithepo (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Kgomaretša JSON go tšwa nyakong ya ditaba ya Jira Cloud REST API (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), goba sedirišwa se se lekanago sa { "issues": [...] }. Maemo a Jira a ba mananeo gomme ditaba tša ba dikarata. O ka akaretša lenaneo la "automationRules" go tliša melao.
import-board-instruction-excel: Kgetha sepreadšiti sa .xlsx sa mokgwa wa WeKan (dikholomo tše di swanago le ntšho ya Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, matšatšikgwedi, mafelo a tlwaelo). Mothaladi wa pele ke hlogo.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Botong ya gago, eya go 'Menu', ke moka 'Export board', gomme o kopolle sengwalwa sa faeleng ye e laollotšwego.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Ge o hwetša diphošo ge o tliša boto, ka dinako tše dingwe go tliša go sa šoma, gomme boto e ba letlakaleng la Diboto ka moka.
import-without-mapping-members: Tliša ntle le go amanya maloko (a amanye ka morago)
import-members-mode-map: Kgethela yo mongwe le yo mongwe wa bona mošomiši yo a lego gona
import-members-mode-placeholder: Ba boloke bjalo ka bašomiši ba nakwana ka maina a bona, go ba kgokaganya le bašomiši ba nnete ka morago
csv-mapping-description: Kgetha kholomo ya faele yeo e swerego lešemo le lengwe le le lengwe la karata. Dikgetho di dirilwe go tšwa go maina a dikholomo; fetoša tše di fošagetšego, gomme o kgethe (ga e gona ka faeleng) bakeng sa lešemo leo faele e se nago lona.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Faele ga e na kholomo ya lelokelelo. Kgetha e tee ka godimo, goba ngwala leina la lelokelelo le tee leo karata ye nngwe le ye nngwe e yago go lona.
csv-mapping-list-name: Lelokelelo la karata ye nngwe le ye nngwe
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Dikholomo tše dingwe tša go tsenywa bjalo ka mašemo a gago a sengwalwa:
csv-mapping-boards: Letlakala le lengwe le le lengwe le fetoga poto ya lona:
csv-mapping-title-required: Kgetha kholomo yeo e swerego dihlogo tša dikarata.
csv-mapping-list-required: Ngwala leina la lelokelelo leo karata ye nngwe le ye nngwe e yago go lona, goba kgetha kholomo yeo e swerego lelokelelo.
invalid-import-mapping: Peakanyo ya dikholomo ga e sepelelane le faele.

Go romela go ngwala malokelelo a poto ye bjalo ka phallo e tee, e reetšwe ka poto, ka JSON yeo API ya Wrike e e bušetšago bakeng sa diphallo tša mošomo: hlama phallo yeo ya mošomo go Wrike pele o tsenya go romela ga Excel ga Wrike ga poto, gore maemo a yona a šomišwe. Go tsenya go bala JSON yeo e kgomareditšwego ka godimo, go tšwa go WeKan goba go GET /workflows ya Wrike, go poto ye e kgethilwego: boemo bjo bo se nago lelokelelo bo fetoga lelokelelo, gomme molao o swaya karata e feditšwe ge e išwa boemong bja Completed goba Cancelled, gomme e sa fela boemong bja Active goba Deferred. Melao ya Wrike ya go itiriša ga e kgone go romelwa go tšwa go Wrike.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Go nyaka go ka akaretša didiriši go kaonafatša patlo. Didiriši di laetšwa ka go ngwala leina la sediriši le boleng di arogantšwe ka khutlonngwe. Mohlala, tlhaloso ya sediriši ya `list:Blocked` e tla lekanyetša patlo go dikarata tše di lego lenaneong le le bitšwago *Blocked*. Ge boleng bo na le dikgoba goba ditlhaka tše di kgethegilego bo swanetše go tsenywa ka gare ga maswao a ditsopolwa (mohl. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - dikarata dibotong tše di swanago le *<title>* ye e laeditšwego
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - dikarata mananeong tše di swanago le *<title>* ye e laeditšwego
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - dikarata methalong ya go rutha ye e swanago le *<title>* ye e laeditšwego
globalSearch-instructions-operator-comme: `__operator_comment__:<text>` - dikarata tše di nago le tshwaotshwao ye e swerego *<text>*.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - dikarata tše di nago le leibole ye e swanago le *<color>* goba *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - dikarata tše *<username>* e lego mohlami wa karata
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - dikarata tša boto ye e abetšwego mokgatlo wa *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - dikarata tša boto ye e abetšwego sehlopha sa *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - dikarata tše di swanetšego go fihla matšatšing a *<n>* go tloga bjale. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ e lokeletša dikarata ka moka tše di fetilwego ke letšatšikgwedi la go swanela.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - dikarata tše di hlamilwego matšatši a *<n>* a fetilego goba ka tlase
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - dikarata tše di fetotšwego matšatši a *<n>* a fetilego goba ka tlase
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - moo *<status>* e lego e tee ya tše di latelago:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - dikarata ka moka tše di lego le tše di sego polokelong
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: `__predicate_ended__` - dikarata tše di nago le letšatšikgwedi la mafelelo
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - dikarata tše di lego feela dibotong tša phatlalatša
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - dikarata tše di lego feela dibotong tša poraebete
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - moo *<field>* e lego e tee ya `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` goba `__predicate_member__`. Go bea `-` pele ga *<field>* go nyaka go se be gona ga boleng lebaleng leo (mohl. `has:-due` e nyaka dikarata tše di se nago letšatšikgwedi la go swanela).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - moo *<sort-name>* e lego e tee ya `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` goba `__predicate_modified__`. Go hlaola ka tatelano ya go theoga, bea `-` pele ga leina la go hlaola.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - moo *<n>* e lego palotlalo ya go feta lefeela ye e laetšago palo ya dikarata tše di tla bontšhwago letlakaleng le lengwe le le lengwe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Didiriši tše dintši di ka laetšwa.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Didiriši tše di swanago di kopanywa ka *OR*. Dikarata tše di swanago le seemo sefe goba sefe di tla bušwa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` e tla buša dikarata tše di lego lenaneong lefe goba lefe le le bitšwago *Blocked* goba *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Didiriši tše di fapanego di kopanywa ka *AND*. Go bušwa feela dikarata tše di swanago le didiriši ka moka tše di fapanego. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` e buša feela dikarata lenaneong la *Available* tše di nago le leibole ye *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Matšatši a ka laetšwa ka palotlalo ya go feta goba ya ka fase ga lefeela goba ka `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` goba `__predicate_year__` bakeng sa nako ya bjale.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Go nyaka sengwalwa ga go šetše tlhaka ye kgolo goba ye nnyane.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Ka tlwaelo dikarata tša polokelong ga di nyakwe.

mongodb-compact-description: Ka morago ga go šuthiša difaele go tšwa go MongoDB GridFS, faele ya polokelo ya tshedimošo tisiking ga e fokotšege ka go itiriša. Go sepediša Compact go bušetša sekgoba se se lokolotšwego ka go ngwala data ya kgoboketšo gape. Sepediša se feela ge go šuthišwa ga difaele ka bontši go fedile.

Diseteng tša dikhopi, tše dingwe ka moka di a pitlaganywa pele (ka go itiriša), ke moka ya motheo. Diseteng tša khophi tša noutu e tee tše di dirišetšwago oplog (peakanyo ya Meteor ye e tlwaelegilego), go pitlaganywa feela ya motheo.

password-length-report-desc: Diakhaonte tšeo di tsenego ka lentšu la sephiri le lekopana go feta botelele bjo bonnyane. Ke sefetleki fela seo se tsebago gore lentšu la sephiri le letelele gakaakang, ka fao se bega le lekopana ka morago ga go tsena; lentšu la sephiri le botelele bja lona ga di ke di tšwa go sona. Go lokišitšwe ke nako yeo lentšu la sephiri la akhaonte le fetošitšwego - akhaonte yeo e tsenago gape ka lentšu la sephiri le lekopana e bontšhwa gape bjalo ka e kopana kudu.

Go le fetoša go ntšha mananeo ka moka a akhaonte. Mantšu a sephiri a LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS le Sandstorm ke a mofani wa ona, gomme ga a hlahlobjwe.

database-migration-description: Huduša data ye e theilwego go sengwalwa (tšohle ka ntle le dikgomaretšwa le diswantšho tša boitsebišo, tše di šalago tshepedišong ya difaele) magareng ga MongoDB le FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Polokelo ye nngwe ya tshedimošo e swanetše go ba e šoma le go fihlelelega (dikgorwana tša tlwaelo: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; fetola ka WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Ge e feditše, šupetša MONGO_URL polokelong ye nngwe ya tshedimošo gomme o thome WeKan gape (go Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb goba =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Hudušetša data ya sengwalwa go FerretDB v1 (SQLite)

database-migration-confirm: Kopišetša dikgoboketšo ka moka tše di theilwego go sengwalwa go __db__? Dikgomaretšwa le diswantšho tša boitsebišo tše di lego tshepedišong ya difaele ga di kgongwe. Polokelo ya tshedimošo ye e lebišitšwego e swanetše go ba e šoma.
database-migration-done: Khudugo ya data ya sengwalwa e phethilwe.
sandstorm-migration-description: Ge WeKan e šoma ka gare ga grain ya Sandstorm, polokelo ya yona ya kgale ya tshedimošo ya MongoDB 3 e hudušetšwa go FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ge e thongwa la mathomo, gomme dikgomaretšwa le diswantšho tša boitsebišo di šuthišwa go tšwa polokelong ya tshedimošo go difolthara tša grain tša files/attachments le files/avatars. Se se bontšha ge khudugo yeo e atlegile le gore difaele tša kgale tše tala tša polokelo ya tshedimošo ya MongoDB di sa diriša sekgoba se se kaakang sa tisiki ka gare ga grain, gomme se go dumelela go phumola difaele tšeo tše tala go lokolla sekgoba.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb: Difaele tše tala tša polokelo ya tshedimošo ya MongoDB 3
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Phumola difaele tše tala tša polokelo ya tshedimošo ya MongoDB
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Ka morago ga khudugo ye e atlegilego data e dula go FerretDB le tshepedišong ya difaele, ka gona difaele tša kgale tše tala tša polokelo ya tshedimošo ya MongoDB 3 di ka phumolwa go lokolla sekgoba sa tisiki sa grain. Se se ka se dirollwe.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Phumola difaele tše tala tša polokelo ya tshedimošo ya MongoDB 3 go lokolla sekgoba sa tisiki? Data e šetše e hudušeditšwe go FerretDB le tshepedišong ya difaele. Se se ka se dirollwe.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Difaele tše tala tša polokelo ya tshedimošo ya MongoDB di phumotšwe, go lokolotšwe
features-desc: Dikarolo tša boikgethelo tšeo WeKan ye e di fago. Karolo ye e sa swaiwago e utwa ponagalong ya motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe. Tshedimošo ya yona e a bolokwa gomme ditumelelo ga di fetoge.
feature-views-table-desc: Poto bjalo ka tafola ya dikarata tše di ka rulaganywago.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Khalentara le khalentara ya dipoto tše dintši.
feature-views-overview-desc: Dipalopalo, go hlopha go ya ka motho yo a abetšwego, leano la tsela, poto ya taolo le poto ye kgolo.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Diponagalo tše tharo tša tšhate ya Gantt.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Lenaneo la mešomo ya setšweletšwa, dipaka tše kopana tša mošomo, pego ya paka ya mošomo le lebelo.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Mošomo wo o šetšego le wo o phethilwego, kelelo ye e kgobokanego, nako ya modikologo le ya go iša, palo ya mošomo wo o phethilwego, nako ye mošomo o bilego gona ka yona, mapheko, Monte Carlo le dikelo tše dingwe tša kelelo.
feature-views-map-desc: Dikarata bjalo ka maswao godimo ga seswantšho se se tsentšwego.
feature-approval-required: Boloka dikarolo tše di oketšwago ke dimpshafatšo tša WeKan di timilwe go fihlela molaodi a di bulela

feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Maina a badiriši, a arogantšwe ka difegelwana
feature-profiles-desc: Profaele e uta dikarolo tše di swailwego go badiriši, dihlopha le mekgatlo yeo e abetšwego yona. Modiriši o botšwa gore o na le profaele efe. Ga go yo a se nago profaele yo a amegago, ga go tshedimošo yeo e tlošwago e bile ga go tumelelo yeo e fetogago.

feature-profile-notice: Profaele ya gago ya dikarolo __name__ e uta dikarolo tše __count__. Botšiša molaodi ge o nyaka e nngwe ya tšona.
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Di bolokilwe. Maina a a badiriši ga se a hwetšwa:
card-field-visibility-desc: Mafelo ao a lego go Dipeakanyo tša poto / Karata ao dipoto di ka a bontšhago. Lefelo leo le sa swaiwago le a utwa dikarateng ka moka, dikarateng tše nnyane le go Dipeakanyo tša poto / Karata tša dipoto ka moka. Datha ya dikarata le dipeakanyo tša dipoto ga di fetoge. Ge le swaiwa gape, poto ye nngwe le ye nngwe e bontšhwa go ya ka dipeakanyo tša yona tša pele. Poto ye nngwe le ye nngwe e na le tatelano ya yona ya mafelo.
cards-loading-auto: Ka go itiriša (go diegišwa feela dibotong tše dikgolo)
cards-loading-lazy: Go diegišwa (dikarata tše di bonagalago feela)
cards-loading-description: WeKan e laiša dikarata tša boto ka go itiriša: boto ye kgolo (ye e fetago mollwane wa bogolo) e laiša feela dikarata tše di bonagalago ga bjale (go sepetša go go sa felego) le palo ya bjale, gore e dule e potlakile gomme e diriše kgopolo le bophara bja kgokagano bjo bonyenyane, mola diboto tše nnyane di laiša karata ye nngwe le ye nngwe bakeng sa boitemogelo bjo bonolo le bjo bo nago le dikarolo ka botlalo. Ga go na seo se swanetšego go beakanywa. Balaodi ba sa dutše ba ka gapeletša mokgwa ka diphetogo tša tikologo tša CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) le CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Go laiša dikarata ka go diega ke ga teko: dipalo tša dikarata le mellwane ya WIP di nepagetše, eupša diponagalo tša Khalentara/Tafola/Gantt le kgetho ya tše dintši di bontšha feela dikarata tše di laišitšwego go fihla bjale. Laiša diboto tše di butšwego gape ka morago ga go fetola se.
render-links-as-plain-text: Bontšha dikgokaganyo bjalo ka sengwalwa feela
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, dikgokaganyo ka moka (bobedi dikgokaganyo tša markdown tša go swana le [label](url) le ditheke tše tala tša HTML <a href>) ka mehla di bontšhwa bjalo ka sengwalwa se se sa kgotlegego lebaleng le lengwe le le lengwe la sengwalwa se se humilego (dihlogo tša boto le karata, ditlhalošo, ditshwaotshwao, mananeo a go hlahloba, bj.bj.). Se se thibela dikgokaganyo tše di kgotlegago tše di forago. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe, ka gona dikgokaganyo di dula di kgotlega.
always-show-code-as-text: Ka mehla bontšha khoutu ka moka bjalo ka sengwalwa feela
always-show-code-as-text-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, sengwalwa se se humilego ga se ke se bontšhwa bjalo ka markdown goba HTML: mothopo ka moka ka mehla o bontšhwa bjalo ka sengwalwa feela lebaleng le lengwe le le lengwe la sengwalwa se se humilego (dihlogo tša boto le karata, ditlhalošo, ditshwaotshwao, mananeo a go hlahloba, bj.bj.). Se se utolla diteng tše di utilwego — ditshwaotshwao tša HTML (<!-- -->), mo dikgokaganyo tša markdown di yago gona, JavaScript le khoutu efe goba efe — gore khoutu ka moka e dule e bonagala, e sa kgotlege e bile e sa šome. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe, ka gona markdown e bontšhwa ka mokgwa wa tlwaelo.
disable-all-import-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, dikarolo ka moka tša go tsenya di a timiwa: go tsenya boto go tšwa go WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea le Forgejo, gammogo le go kopiša boto. Dikgetho tša menyu wa go tsenya di a fihliwa gomme sebara e gana kgopelo efe goba efe ya go tsenya. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
import-max-megabytes: Go tsenya mo go kgolo kudu (MB)
import-max-megabytes-description: Faele ye kgolo kudu yeo letlakala la Tsenya le e amogelago, ka di-megabyte. Ge go se na selo go ra gore ga go na mellwane: faele e ka ba kgolo go fihla moo sekgoba se se lokologilego sa disiki se dumelelago go tsenya go fela. Go laiša go go go lengwe le le lengwe go ngwalwa disiking ya sebara karolo ka karolo, gomme go tsenya mo go ka tlatšago disiki go a ganwa.
import-disk-full: Ga go na sekgoba se se lekanego se se lokologilego disiking ya sebara bakeng sa go tsenya mo.
import-upload-not-found: Faele ye e laišitšwego ga e sa le gona. E kgethe gape.
import-upload-failed: Faele ga e a kgona go laišwa.
import-upload-aborted: Go laiša go ile gwa šitišwa.
disable-all-export-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, dikarolo ka moka tša go ntšha di a timiwa: go ntšha boto bjalo ka WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, goba go NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, le go ntšha sekgomaretšwa se tee. Dikgetho tša menyu wa go ntšha di a fihliwa gomme sebara e gana kgopelo efe goba efe ya go ntšha. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
disable-import-avatars: Tima go tsenya diswantšho tša boitsebišo
disable-import-avatars-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, diswantšho tša boitsebišo (diswantšho tša profaele ya mošomiši) ga di ke di tsenywa. Se se akaretša go tsenya WeKan JSON, go tsenya Trello le go nyalantšha diswantšho tša boitsebišo go tšwa go baneedi ba boitsebišo ba ka ntle ge go tsenwa (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Maina le data ye nngwe di sa tsenywa; go tshelwa feela diswantšho tša boitsebišo. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
disable-export-avatars: Tima go ntšha diswantšho tša boitsebišo
disable-export-avatars-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, diswantšho tša boitsebišo (diswantšho tša profaele ya mošomiši) ga di ke di akaretšwa ge boto e ntšhwa (ntšho ya WeKan JSON le CSV). Maina a badiriši le data ye nngwe di sa ntšhwa; go tlogelwa feela diswantšho tša boitsebišo. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
anonymize-import-users: Tloša boitsebišo bja badiriši ba ba tsenywago
anonymize-import-users-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, go tsenya boto ya WeKan JSON go tšeela leina la mošomiši, leina ka botlalo le ditlhaka tša mathomo tša mošomiši yo mongwe le yo mongwe yo a tsentšwego legato ka diswari tša lefelo tša sebadi (user1, user2, ...), go tloša seswantšho sa gagwe sa boitsebišo, le go ngwala gape dipolelo tša @username (le mabala a requested-by / assigned-by) ka gare ga diteng tša karata le tshwaotshwao tše di tsentšwego. Ga go boitsebišo bja nnete bja mošomiši go tšwa botong ya mothopo bjo bo bolokwago. Lentšu la "mošomiši" le latela leleme la motho yo a tsenyago. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
anonymize-export-users: Tloša boitsebišo bja badiriši ba ba ntšhwago
anonymize-export-users-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, go ntšha boto go tšeela leina la mošomiši, leina ka botlalo le ditlhaka tša mathomo tša mošomiši yo mongwe le yo mongwe yo a ntšhwago legato ka diswari tša lefelo tša sebadi (user1, user2, ...), go tloša seswantšho sa gagwe sa boitsebišo, le go ngwala gape dipolelo tša @username (le mabala a requested-by / assigned-by) ka gare ga diteng tša karata le tshwaotshwao. Faele ye e ntšhitšwego ga e na boitsebišo bja nnete bja mošomiši. Lentšu la "mošomiši" le latela leleme la motho yo a ntšhago. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
anonymize-account: Tloša boitsebišo bja badiriši ba ba tsenywago
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Ge se dumeletšwe, go ntšha boto go tšeela leina la mošomiši, leina ka botlalo le ditlhaka tša mathomo tša mošomiši yo mongwe le yo mongwe yo a ntšhwago legato ka diswari tša lefelo tša sebadi (user1, user2, ...), go tloša seswantšho sa gagwe sa boitsebišo, le go ngwala gape dipolelo tša @username (le mabala a requested-by / assigned-by) ka gare ga diteng tša karata le tshwaotshwao. Faele ye e ntšhitšwego ga e na boitsebišo bja nnete bja mošomiši. Lentšu la "mošomiši" le latela leleme la motho yo a ntšhago. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
disable-activities-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, dikgatišo tša phepelo ya mešongwana ga di ngwalwe e bile ga di bontšhwe kae goba kae (para ya ka thoko ya boto le thepe ya mošongwana wa karata). Ga go histori ya gore ke mang yo a dirilego eng ye e bolokwago. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
disable-notifications-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, WeKan ga e romele ditsebišo tša go bogela (ka gare ga tirišo, imeile goba ditirelo tše dingwe) tša mošongwana ofe goba ofe. Mešongwana e sa ka ngwalwa (ntle le ge le yona e timilwe ka godimo); go thibelwa feela ditsebišo. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
disable-watch-description: Ge se dumeletšwe, karolo ya go bogela e a timiwa — badiriši ba ka se ingwadišetše diboto, mananeo goba dikarata go amogela ditsebišo, gomme maiteko afe goba afe a go fetola maemo a go bogela a a ganwa. Ka tlwaelo se timilwe.
backup-description: Boloka khophi ya Dikgomaretšwa, Diswantšho tša boitsebišo le/goba Data (dikgoboketšo ka moka tše di theilwego go sengwalwa tše e sego dikgomaretšwa goba diswantšho tša boitsebišo). .zip e elela thwii go polokelo ye e kgethilwego — ga go faele ya nakwana — bjalo ka backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, e swerego YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars le /data. Dipolokelo tša leru (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) di diriša mangwalo a netefatšo ao a beakantšwego dithepong tša tšona tša polokelo.
backup-scope-description: Sistimi ka moka, goba Mokgatlo o tee. Khophi ya polokelo ya Mokgatlo e swere diboto tša wona le tšohle tše di lego go tšona, go akaretšwa dikgomaretšwa tša diboto tšeo — eupša ga e na diakhaonto tša badiriši le dipeakanyo tša sistimi, ka gobane tšeo di abelanwa ke Mokgatlo wo mongwe le wo mongwe. Go bušetša khophi ya polokelo ya Mokgatlo go ngwala feela dibotong tše Mokgatlo woo o nago le tšona.
theme-override-all-tenants: Phetošo ye e šomago go bahiri ka moka
backup-schedule: Dikhophi tša polokelo tše di beakantšwego
backup-frequency-daily: Letšatši le lengwe le le lengwe
backup-frequency-weekly: Beke ye nngwe le ye nngwe
backup-frequency-monthly: Kgwedi ye nngwe le ye nngwe
continuous-backup: Khophi ya polokelo ye e tšwelago pele
continuous-backup-description: E romela phetogo ye nngwe le ye nngwe ya polokelo ya tshedimošo, dikgomaretšwa, diswantšho tša boitsebišo le direkhoto go foltara ka metsotswana ye mmalwa, gore go bušetšwe seemo sa nako efe goba efe. E šoma mmogo le khophi ya polokelo ye e beakanyeditšwego nako, ye e hlolago dipolokelo tše di feletšego.
continuous-backup-enabled: Diriša khophi ya polokelo ye e tšwelago pele go sebara ye
continuous-backup-target: Foltara ye go išwago go yona (tsela ye e feletšego go tisiki ye nngwe, lefelong le le abelanwago la netweke goba lefelong le le kgokagantšwego ka rclone)
wekan-data-no-database: Ga go a hwetšwa polokelo ya tshedimošo ya WeKan yeo e balegago.
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (ka nako ya nnete, phetogo ye nngwe le ye nngwe)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Matlakala a SQLite (matlakala ao a fetogilego nakong ye nngwe le ye nngwe)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (lenaneo leo o ka kgethago go le tsenya)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Ga go entšene ya polokelo ya tshedimošo ye e ka šomago go sebara ye
continuous-backup-base-every: Dira khophi ya motheo ye mpsha ka morago ga (diiri)
continuous-backup-encrypt: Fihla khophi ya polokelo ka khoutu (AES-256-GCM)
continuous-backup-key-file: Faele ya senotlelo sa go fihla ka khoutu (tsela ye e feletšego ka ntle ga foltara ye go išwago go yona; ditlhaka tše 64 tša mokgwa wa dipalo wo o theilwego go 16 goba polelwana ya sephiri ye e nago le bonyane ditlhaka tše 16). Boloka khophi: ntle le faele ye, khophi ya polokelo e ka se bušetšwe.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Ga go na lefelo (foltareng ye go išwago go yona fela)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Foltara ka gare ga setshelo sa polokelo
continuous-backup-fetched: Difaele di tšerwe go tšwa lerung
continuous-backup-litestream-binary: Faele ye e phethagatšwago ya Litestream (tsela ye e feletšego)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Faele ya polokelo ya tshedimošo ya SQLite (e hlongwa kgauswi le khophi ya polokelo, ga e ke e ngwala godimo ga faele ye e dirišwago)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Diriša polokelo ya tshedimošo ya SQLite ye e agilwego leswa ge tshepedišo e thoma gape nakong ye e latelago (polokelo ya tshedimošo ya kgale ye e tšeetšwego legato e tla bolokwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Bušetša moloko wo o kgethilwego seemong sa nako ye e kgethilwego? Khophi ya polokelo ye e tšwelago pele e tla ema nakwana ge go bušetšwa.
continuous-backup-saved: Dipeakanyo tša khophi ya polokelo ye e tšwelago pele di bolokilwe
backup-restore-add-missing: Tsenya feela data ye e hlaelago
backup-restore-select-first: Kgetha khophi ya polokelo lenaneong pele.
backup-restore-confirm: Bušetša khophi ya polokelo ye e kgethilwego? Dikgomaretšwa/diswantšho tša boitsebišo di ngwalwa tshepedišong ya difaele gomme data polokelong ya tshedimošo go ya ka mokgwa wo o kgethilwego.
gcs-key-filename: Tsela ya faele ya senotlelo sa akhaonto ya tirelo
gcs-key-filename-description: Ya boikgethelo: tsela ya faele ya senotlelo sa JSON sa akhaonto ya tirelo sebareng.
gcs-credentials: Mangwalo a netefatšo a akhaonto ya tirelo (JSON)
gcs-credentials-description: Ya boikgethelo: kgomaretša senotlelo sa JSON sa akhaonto ya tirelo. Tlogela go se na selo go diriša faele ya senotlelo goba mangwalo a netefatšo a tlwaelo.
gcs-permissions-note: Fa akhaonto ya tirelo ya WeKan phihlelelo ya go bala/go ngwala paketeng: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → pakete ya gago → Permissions → Grant access. Go "New principals", kgomaretša imeile ya akhaonto ya tirelo — boleng bja "client_email" go tšwa senotlelong sa gago sa JSON — ke moka o kgethe karolo ya "Storage Object Admin" gomme o Boloke.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Tlogela go se na selo go boloka boleng bja bjale.
azure-account-name-description: Leina la akhaonto ya gago ya Azure Storage.
azure-container-description: Seswaro sa blob seo difaele di bolokwago go sona.
gcs-project-id-description: ID ya protšeke ya gago ya Google Cloud.
gcs-bucket-description: Leina la pakete ya Cloud Storage ye difaele di bolokwago go yona.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: tlogela go se na selo (e diriša ntlha ya mafelelo ya selete). Ye e sepelelanago le S3: URL ya Endpoint go tšwa khonsoleng ya gago ya MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → pakete ya gago → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → leina la pakete ya gago (goba Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → mošomiši wa gago → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → kgetha taba ya tšhomišo ya 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. E bontšhwa bjalo ka 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Sekirini se se swanago le Access key ID; 'Secret access key' e bontšhwa gatee feela ge senotlelo se hlangwa — se kopiše ka nako yeo (goba Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaonto ya gago → leina le le bontšhwago godimo (gape ka fase ga Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaonto ya gago → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaonto ya gago → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhaonto ya gago → Data storage → Containers → seswaro sa gago (goba + Container go hlama se seswa).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → sekgethi sa protšeke godimo → ID ya protšeke ya gago (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → leina la pakete ya gago (goba Create go hlama ye mpsha).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Tsela sebareng ya WeKan ya go ya faeleng ya senotlelo sa JSON sa akhaonto ya tirelo ye e taoneloutitšwego (ye e hlamilwego ka tlase). Diriša se GOBA o kgomaretše JSON lebaleng le le lego ka tlase.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → akhaonto ya gago ya tirelo → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (e taonelouta faele). Kgomaretša diteng tša yona mo, goba boloka faele gomme o beakanye tsela ya yona ka godimo.
cloud-secret-set: (e bolokilwe — tlogela go se na selo go e boloka)
cloud-settings-save-failed: Go boloka dipeakanyo tša polokelo go paletšwe
cloud-settings-desc: Ka WeKan go Weddy, Cloud Panel e direla di-domain tše dintši tša WeKan go tšwa go seva e tee, ye nngwe le ye nngwe e na le data ya yona. Go Domain ya Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin o laola di-domain le CloudFlare.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel ke ya SuperAdmin fela, go Domain ya Cloud Panel.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ka senotlelo sa CloudFlare API, domain yeo zone ya yona e lego akhaonteng ya gago ya CloudFlare e hwetša rekhoto ya DNS ya proxy le setifikeiti sa CloudFlare Origin. Di-domain tše dingwe di hwetša setifikeiti sa Let's Encrypt. Senotlelo se bolokwa go seva gomme ga se sa tla bontšhwa gape.
cloudflare-api-key-set: Senotlelo sa CloudFlare API se bolokilwe.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Ga go senotlelo sa CloudFlare API seo se bolokilwego: domain ye nngwe le ye nngwe e hwetša setifikeiti sa Let's Encrypt.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Šuthišetša sekgomaretšwa go Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Šuthišetša sekgomaretšwa go Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Diriša MongoDB GridFS bakeng sa polokelo ya difaele
migration-pause-failed: Go emiša dikhudugo nakwana go paletšwe
migration-paused: Dikhudugo di emišitšwe nakwana ka katlego
migration-not-needed: Ga go khudugo ye e nyakegago
migration-stop-confirm: Na o kgonthišegile gore o nyaka go emiša dikhudugo ka moka?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Gore dikgomaretšwa le diswantšho tša boitsebišo di bonagale, di šuthiše go tšwa go CollectionFS go ya Polokelong efe goba efe ye nngwe.
s3-access-key-description: Senotlelo sa phihlelelo sa AWS S3 bakeng sa netefatšo
s3-access-key-placeholder: Tsenya senotlelo sa phihlelelo sa S3
s3-bucket-description: Leina la pakete ya S3 la go boloka difaele
s3-enabled-description: Diriša AWS S3 goba MinIO bakeng sa polokelo ya difaele
s3-endpoint-description: URL ya ntlha ya mafelelo ya S3 (mohlala s3.amazonaws.com goba minio.example.com)
s3-port-description: Nomoro ya kou ya ntlha ya mafelelo ya S3
s3-secret-key-description: Senotlelo sa sephiri sa AWS S3 bakeng sa netefatšo
s3-secret-key-placeholder: Tsenya senotlelo sa sephiri sa S3
s3-secret-key-required: Senotlelo sa sephiri sa S3 se a nyakega
s3-settings-save-failed: Go boloka dipeakanyo tša S3 go paletšwe
s3-settings-saved: Dipeakanyo tša S3 di bolokilwe ka katlego
s3-ssl-enabled-description: Diriša SSL/TLS bakeng sa dikgokagano tša S3
schedule-board-backup: Beakanya Khophi ya Polokelo ya Boto
scheduled-board-operations: Ditiro tša Boto tše di Beakantšwego
writable-path-description: Tsela ya folthara ya motheo bakeng sa polokelo ya difaele
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: E dira ditlhahlobo le ditokišo ka botlalo tša botshepegi bja data ya boto, go akaretšwa tatelano ya mananeo, maemo a dikarata le sebopego sa methalo ya go rutha.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration: Phumola Mananeo a go Boeletšwa a go se be le Selo
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: E phumola ka polokego mananeo a go boeletšwa a go se be le selo. E tloša feela mananeo ao a se nago dikarata E BILE a na le lenaneo le lengwe le le nago le sehlogo se se swanago leo le swerego dikarata.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: E hwetša le go bušetša dikarata le mananeo ao a se nago swimlaneId goba listId. E hlama mothalo wa go rutha wa 'Dikarata tše di Timetšego' go dira gore dilo ka moka tše di timetšego di bonagale gape.
restore-all-archived-migration: Bušetša Tšohle tše di Lego Polokelong
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: E bušetša methalo ya go rutha, mananeo le dikarata ka moka tše di lego polokelong. E lokiša swimlaneId goba listId efe goba efe ye e hlaelago ka go itiriša gore dilo di bonagale.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: E lemoga le go lokiša mananeo a a hlaelago goba a a senyegilego sebopegong sa boto.
fix-avatar-urls-migration: Lokiša di-URL tša Diswantšho tša Boitsebišo
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: E mpshafatša di-URL tša diswantšho tša boitsebišo tša maloko a boto gore di diriše polokelo ya ka morago ye e nepagetšego le go lokiša ditšhupetšo tše di robegilego tša diswantšho tša boitsebišo.
fix-all-file-urls-migration: Lokiša di-URL ka Moka tša Difaele
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: E mpshafatša di-URL ka moka tša dikgomaretšwa tša difaele botong ye gore di diriše polokelo ya ka morago ye e nepagetšego le go lokiša ditšhupetšo tše di robegilego tša difaele.
migrations-admin-only: Ke balaodi ba boto feela bao ba ka sepedišago dikhudugo
migrations-description: Sepediša ditlhahlobo le ditokišo tša botshepegi bja data bakeng sa boto ye. Khudugo ye nngwe le ye nngwe e ka phethagatšwa ka boyona.
no-issues-found: Ga go na mathata a hweditšwego
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Se se tla dira khudugo ka botlalo go hlahloba le go lokiša botshepegi bja data ya boto. Se se ka tšea metsotswana ye mmalwa. Tšwela pele?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Se se tla thoma ka go fetolela mananeo afe goba afe a abelanwego go mananeo a mothalo wo mongwe le wo mongwe wa go rutha, ke moka se phumole mananeo a go se be le selo ao a nago le lenaneo la go boeletšwa le le nago le sehlogo se se swanago leo le swerego dikarata. Go tla tlošwa feela mananeo a go se be le selo ao a sa nyakegego ka nnete. Tšwela pele?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Se se tla hlama mothalo wa go rutha wa 'Dikarata tše di Timetšego' le go bušetša dikarata le mananeo ka moka ao a se nago swimlaneId goba listId. Se se kgoma feela dilo tše di sego polokelong. Tšwela pele?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Se se tla bušetša methalo ya go rutha, mananeo le dikarata KA MOKA tše di lego polokelong, tša bonagala gape. Dilo dife goba dife tše di se nago di-ID di tla lokišwa ka go itiriša. Se ga se dirollege gabonolo. Tšwela pele?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Se se tla lemoga le go lokiša mananeo a a hlaelago goba a a senyegilego sebopegong sa boto. Tšwela pele?

scrum-daily-observations: Bogolo bja mošomo le mošomo wo o šetšego letšatši le letšatši (ditemogo)
scrum-daily-observations-help: Kholomo ye nngwe le ye nngwe e bontšha temogo ya mathomo ye e rekotilwego ya letšatši la UTC, ka nako ye e bontšhitšwego. Matšatši ao a sego gona a a tlogelwa. Ditemogo tše ga di rekote phetogo ye nngwe le ye nngwe goba go bontšha palomoka ya mafelelong a letšatši. Ditekanyetšo tše di sa tsebjego ga se lefela. Šomiša tiro ya Romela ya karolo ye bakeng sa ditemogo tša letšatši le letšatši; tiro ya Romela ya bara ya didirišwa e romela dipoelo tša potologo ya mošomo.

scrum-scope-history-help: E agilwe leswa go tšwa historing ya poto go tloga mathomong a nako ya mošomo: mothaladi o tee bakeng sa phetogo ye nngwe le ye nngwe dikarateng tša nako ya mošomo, dikakanyong goba mošomong wo o phethilwego.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Histori ga e tšweletše leswa seswantšho sa boemo bja nako ye ya mošomo ka boyona: diphetogo tše dingwe di dirilwe ntle le go ngwalwa historing, ka fao boleng bjo ga se bja felela.

scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Temogo ya mathomo ye e rekotilwego ya letšatši le lengwe le le lengwe la UTC; matšatši ao a sego gona a a tlogelwa. Ditemogo ga di rekote phetogo ye nngwe le ye nngwe goba palomoka ya mafelelong a letšatši. Ditekanyetšo tše di sa tsebjego ga se lefela.

scrum-import-discard: Khansela go tsenya mo go sa felelago

scrum-import-into-board-hint: Kgetha faele ya poto ya WeKan ye e rometšwego ntle goba faele ya phetišetšo ya Scrum. Dipotologo tša mošomo le ditokollo tše di šetšego di le potong ye di a kgokaganywa, ga di dirwe dikopi. Dikarata di nyalantšhwa ka ID goba ka nomoro le sehlogo sa karata; dikarata tše di sa nyalanego di a lokeletšwa gomme di tlogelwa di sa fetolwa. Lebelela ponelopele pele go bona tše di tlago go fetoga.
